caption:
Hybrid policy in India is consolidating around one rule: senior stakeholder meetings happen in person. Which means your office days are no longer work days. They are evaluation days.

You used to have five days of ambient presence. Corridor conversations. Being seen thinking. A bad Tuesday absorbed by a good Thursday. That cushion is gone. Your judgment now gets assessed in roughly four hours a week, in a room with the people who decide your next role.

In command, we called this a compressed window. You do not get it back. You prepare for it.

Three things carry you in a compressed window. Bearing 
take your seat like it was assigned to you. Tone 
flat, unhurried, no upward lilt at the end of a statement. Silence 
answer the question, then stop talking. The pause after your sentence is where authority registers.

Four hours. Treat them like the inspection they are.

topic.title: Hybrid concentrated your judgment into four office hours
topic.angle: If Indian hybrid policy now reserves office time for senior stakeholder meetings, office hours become evaluation hours — bearing, tone and silence do all the work, with no week of ambient presence to fall back on.
